title: salvia protracta
intro: Salvia protracta, commonly known as Red Sage, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This perennial herb is native to the southwestern United States and has been used for centuries for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Salvia protracta include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
